company.name: The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description:
• Develop a community on a residence hall floor of 35+ ethnically diverse undergraduate students
• Enforce University and Residence hall policies resulting in a safe, orderly, and enjoyable living environment
• Implement programs for residents to enhance the social, educational, community, and personal development

positions.title: Software Developer Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed an endpoint in our API to automate the process of bouncing an application
- Initiated the first UI for the team by bringing RCP capabilities directly to clients via Backstage app
- Increase efficiency of EG developers by 11%

Languages used: Go lang, Typescript
Tools used: Kubernetes, Kubefed, Helm, Spinnaker, Backstage
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · TypeScript · REST APIs · Software Development · Go (Programming Language) · Git · Helm Charts

positions.title: Business Operations Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and built a new website for the company 
• Increased company efficiency by building a new online application process for new clients; where now the client can submit an online application and do onboarding tasks quickly instead of back-to-back communication
• Support continuous improvement and organizational development projects

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
• Researched target accounts and clients to increase outreach; lead generation
• Made necessary updates on WordPress for company's blogs
• Developed and executed marketing strategies that increased engagement rate by 28% , including researching and tracking down related articles for social media outreach
• Maximized efficiency in consulting workshops for clients by researching the industry, resulting in creating a personalized experience and building a relationship with the client

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Students + Startups is an internship program that connects talented students with local small businesses and startups in San Antonio, Texas. Interns gain valuable hands-on experience as they experience the exciting, stressful, and immensely rewarding life at one of S+S's many company partners. The goal is to showcase that the Alamo City is full of career-launching opportunities by connecting top talent with the growing businesses within the San Antonio ecosystem. 

Learn more at https://studentsstartups.com.

positions.title: Student Associate
positions.description:
• Monitor the front desk, including telecommunications, emails, and visitors
• Manage to complete all office administrative duties quickly
• Contribute with ensuring confidential materials were handled properly

positions.title: Marketing and Events Assistant
positions.description:
• Promoted Dollar General & ESPN companies + products via social media platforms
• Increase engagement with fans with various activities, games and sweepstakes
• Interacted with 200+ fans to increase engagement and bring a better experience
